thread:
Marta: Morning team 4aa Need a quick ops sync: webinar post + benchmark narrative go live Friday. Scope: redirects, internal links from resource hub, JSON-LD, and inbound lead routing checks. Any blockers?
Owen: I can run a focused crawl and surface redirect chains and duplicate-title issues. ETA: today afternoon.
Tariq: I'll owner canonical strategy and interim canonical hints if we can't flatten redirects before go-live. Also will coordinate with ops for fast rollback.
Nina: I'll handle on-page copy tweaks and messaging iterations for the blog + CTA routing to /get-started. Want to test two meta descriptions for CTR.
Marta: Core keyword targets: "LLM inference latency", "inference cost optimization", and a conversion-focused long-tail: "reduce production LLM serving cost". Use those across H1/H2 and schema.
Owen: Found a recurring two-hop: /legacy-cases -> /demos/old -> /demos/latency-demo. Recommend collapsing to single 301 to /benchmarks/latency.
Tariq: If we can't flatten, add rel="canonical" on /demos/old pointing to /benchmarks/latency and mark the legacy as noindex,follow temporarily.
Nina: For AB test of meta we should ensure the canonical stays the same across variants to avoid split signals. Also we'll add an internal hero link from /resources/overview.
Owen: Quick Cloudflare Worker redirect example (param-preserving):
```js
addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  const url = new URL(event.request.url)
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/legacy-cases/')) {
    url.pathname = url.pathname.replace('/legacy-cases/', '/benchmarks/latency/')
    return event.respondWith(Response.redirect(url.toString(), 301))
  }
  return event.respondWith(fetch(event.request))
})
```
Marta: Love the worker rule. Keeps the edge fast. Make sure UTM preservation is explicit in the worker logic.
Tariq: JSON-LD plan: Event + VideoObject + breadcrumbList. I'll draft minimal schema for the page head and push PR. We should include "interactionStatistic" for attendance numbers after recording is posted.
Nina: Messaging iteration notes: headline variants: A) "Scaling LLM Inference: Benchmarks & Playbook" B) "Cut LLM Serving Cost Without Sacrificing Latency". I'll push both to the content doc for review.
SEO_Bot: Quick scan complete: 39 pages missing canonicals, 6 redirect chains, 2 duplicate-title groups. Crawl ID: cr-2026-06-09-linkops.
Marta: Owners & deliverables: Owen = redirect map + worker rule PR, Tariq = canonical strategy + JSON-LD PR, Nina = copy + meta ABs + internal link list. Target: all PRs by Thu EOD so we can do final smoke on Fri morning.
Owen: I'll flag any high-risk slugs in the PR. If we hit time constraints, Tariq will apply interim canonical hints.
Tariq: I'll prepare the canonical + noindex fallback script for the ops team so we can toggle quickly.
Nina: Will also add 2 contextual links from top resource hub pages to the webinar page and the benchmarks post to boost internal equity.
Marta: Great. Keep this thread as the source of truth and paste PR links here. If anyone runs into blocked assets from robots, ping IT and tag @infra. :rocket:
